title: Stanford University Annual Financial Report 2001
page: Note 12 (University Gifts note precedes it) – “Changes in the University’s endowment” roll-forward, PDF p. 54
notes: Audited Consolidated Financial Statements. “Endowment, end of year” gives FY2001 = $8,249,551 thousand and FY2000 = $8,885,905 thousand, in thousands of dollars, as of August 31 (Stanford's own fiscal year end – see the Stanford as-of dating section in data/README.md). This is the University's own endowment figure, distinct from the Merged Pool market value SMC reports separately as of June 30; see the Merged-Pool-is-not-the-endowment finding in data/README.md. FY2001's closing balance is independently confirmed by the FY2003 report's own comparative note (smc-annual-financial-report-2003), which reprints it as FY2002's opening balance.
